environment: API 35 emulator, 2400x1080 landscape, ADB touch input with rendered screenshot inspection
observed: Home Play closes the menu and enters the opening
Bag icon opens shared inventory and Close Bag dismisses it
Joystick swipe moves along the hall
Ghost patrol reaches and catches an exposed player
Try Again starts a new round without replaying the opening
Journal icon opens the letter panel and Fold Letter dismisses it
Menu opens and Resume returns to gameplay
limitations: Single emulator smoke test; does not validate physical multitouch comfort or phone performance. Network join UI is covered separately.
